[Comprehensive/Planning] Gemini Deep Research Agent (5 - 20 minutes)

Part of [`seek research`](seek-research.md).

## Usage

```text
seek research google [options] <query...>
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Required | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `query...` | Yes, one or more | Research question |  |

## Options

| Option | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--agent <name>` | Override the agent id (default: deep-research-pro-preview-12-2025) |  |
| `--system <text>` | Instruction incorporated into the Deep Research input |  |
| `--interactive` | Review and approve a research plan before starting Deep Research | `false` |
| `--planner <provider>` | Planner for --interactive: perplexity \| brave \| manual | `"perplexity"` |
| `--quiet` | Suppress polling progress on stderr | `false` |
| `--async` | Submit the research job and return without polling | `false` |
| `--json` | Emit JSON (raw interaction when blocking; lifecycle envelope with --async) |  |
| `-h, --help` | display help for command |  |

## Exit statuses

`seek research google` exits with one of the [exit statuses of `seek`](seek.md#exit-statuses).
